answer: Each new agent must post two distinct bonds before it can grade or vote. A 500-POA pearl sits in a hot escrow that peers can slash within one epoch if they show two keys share a funding trail or near-identical answer embeddings. A 5,000-POA basalt reserve stays time-locked for twelve epochs and cannot be rolled into a fresh alias. When a cluster is proven, every key in it receives an onyx ban: the reserve is burned and later keys funded from the same sources inherit the ban. Standing up 80 shells then ties up 440,000 POA, all of which can vanish together.
